_readme: Live result feeds. Every race uses the feeds listed for its state under stateFeeds and finds its contest automatically (contest: 'auto' matches any common spelling of 'U.S. House District N'). To add a source on election night, paste the results URL into the feed's url and save; the collector rereads this file on every pass. Override a single race under races, e.g. "NY-17": [{"feed": "rockland", "contest": "auto"}, {"feed": "westchester", "contest": "auto"}]. Adapters: ncsbe, clarity, enhanced-voting, fl-dos, delimited, json (see collector/adapters/*.js for their options).

nc.note: NC State Board of Elections statewide precinct file (verified: live, zero counts before polls close)

fl-dos.note: Florida DOS election-night file, county level. Add county Supervisor of Elections feeds for precinct detail.

ga.note: Georgia SOS (Enhanced Voting). URL follows the 2024 pattern (2024NovGen); confirm on the night.

va.hint: Virginia ELECT results site. Paste the election's public results URL; if it is not an Enhanced Voting site, switch the adapter to json or delimited.

sc.hint: SC Election Commission results (Clarity). Paste the statewide results URL, e.g. https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/SC/<id>/web.<n>/#/summary

co.hint: Colorado SOS results (Clarity). Paste the statewide results URL.

ia.hint: Iowa SOS results (Clarity). Paste the statewide results URL.

ky.hint: Kentucky: state results are county level; use county clerk pages (Clarity county URLs work, add one feed per county).

in.hint: Indiana ENR (enr.indianavoters.in.gov) or county pages. Configure json/delimited mapping.

oh.hint: Ohio: county boards of elections (Hamilton, Montgomery, Lucas, Summit...). One feed per county.

pa.hint: Pennsylvania: county results pages (Bucks, Lehigh, Northampton, Monroe, Lackawanna, Luzerne...). One feed per county.

mi.hint: Michigan: county clerks (Kent, Ottawa, Kalamazoo, Macomb...). One feed per county.

nj.hint: New Jersey: county clerks. One feed per county.

tx.hint: Texas: county elections offices (Hidalgo, Cameron, Harris, Dallas, Travis...). Texas SOS is county level.

me.hint: Maine reports by town after counting; use a town-level CSV if one is published.

ny.hint: New York: county boards (Rockland, Westchester, Putnam, Dutchess).

az.hint: Arizona: Maricopa / Pima / Pinal / Coconino county results files.

wi.hint: Wisconsin: county clerks (often CSV or PDF).

ca.hint: California: county registrars (Kern, Tulare, Kings; San Diego, Riverside).
